description: Search Amazon products by keyword or category — returns matching ASINs with title, brand, price, rank, estimated units sold, reviews, and rating from the Jungle Scout product database. Example: junglescout_product_database({ keyword: "yoga mat", marketplace: "us", _apiKey: "KEY_NAME:API_KEY" })

category.description: Amazon category to filter by, e.g. "Sports & Outdoors". Pass keyword and/or category.

keyword.description: Keyword/phrase products must include, e.g. "yoga mat"

name: junglescout_product_database
title: Junglescout Product Database
